author.exposure: Same-split source author reused: own closed v1/v2 exploratory source and v3 complete source/synthetic/ingestion evidence; not pristine or independent source reviewer.

independent_reviewer.exposure: Same-split source reviewer reused: own6 documents/66 chunks/license/Java evidence/source semantics; not source/item author.

contract: Reuse generic draft_contract of next-stage-registration-v3 and concrete family_id/source_kind/cases ordering/logical ID contract in execution design. Whole accepted own corpus determines truth/absence and all sufficient evidence alternatives; no retrieval or model-tailored selection.
read_scope: Accepted own split source bindings and generic registered code/design only. No other-split or closed question/oracle/source semantics or model outputs.
questions_payload: schema_version, phase, cases; each id/query/language/family_id/source_kind public|synthetic; no runtime UUID, context or oracle facts.
execution_mapping: Manifest maps logical source IDs to actual current document/revision/chunk IDs and predeclared workspace/principal. Search kind=all, hybrid_rerank/base/top5; no evidence-location filters. Driver never reads oracle.
dispatch_gate: Accepted source freeze and this registration committed with exact required CI success, then explicit author dispatch. Independent reviewer starts after author return and separate dispatch.
freeze_gate: Independent full acceptance before item freeze; rejected author originals remain unchanged.
common_boundaries: No locked test or other split semantics
No human review, approval or model quality claims
